# Step 2.128: your name, your password, your email

## Layer 1, the name

Found (builder 1):

- A new account is made with no name: the code proves the address, then `choosePassword`
  (`server/sign-in/flows.ts`) or Google; the first request links or makes the account in
  `identify` (`server/database-ports.ts`, `accountOfSignIn`; the stand-in: `stand-in-ports.ts`).
- A person's own profile: a `profiles` row joined by `profile_access` relation `self`, made
  once by `public.create_own_profile` (0012). Admins reads `accounts.display_name`.
- Every way in reads the session through `ports.identify` (request-facts.ts): the gate.

Done (builder 1, 61af9e0d; T-445, T-446):

- Gate: `identify` refuses an account with no own profile with the account problem
  `name-needed`; pages send that to `/account`, which draws the one name screen.
  `ports.ownName.accountOf` is the only read of the account before the gate.
- Commands `give-own-name.ts`, `change-own-name.ts` (core, people); queries
  `read-own-name.ts`, `rename-own-profile.ts` (also sets `accounts.display_name`). Form

- Seed members and the test copy's owner have no own profile: asked at the next sign-in.
